title: Ceramide Ring Trial — NIST RM 8231 Young African-American
description: Per-laboratory and consensus ceramide concentrations in NIST RM 8231 Young African-American from the interlaboratory ceramide ring trial. Reports 39 laboratory methods (LabNum 1-34) measuring four ceramides, with single-point and multi-point calibration, alongside the published consensus values with and without outliers. Outliers were determined per ceramide and reference material using Tukey's 1.5 x IQR fences.

publicationMetadata.title: Concordant inter-laboratory derived concentrations of ceramides in human plasma reference materials via authentic standards
publicationMetadata.description: Nature Communications publication of the interlaboratory ceramide ring trial study
